# Hello, my valued subscriber!

![free live webinar on healing hypothyroid](/images/migrated/hello-my-valued-subscriber/image.png)

It’s a pleasure to connect with you once again. You already know me as Dr. Ian Hollaman, or Dr. Autoimmune, and you’re aware of my dedication to functional medicine and my pioneering work on hypothyroidism and autoimmunity. Now, I’m thrilled to extend a personal invitation to you for my FREE Webinar on “Healing Hypothyroid.”

Hyperthyroidism is a condition where the thyroid gland becomes overactive, producing an excess of thyroid hormones. This can lead to various symptoms like rapid heartbeat, weight loss, anxiety, and more.

Autoimmunity plays a significant role in some cases of hyperthyroidism, particularly in a condition called Graves’ disease, which I have extensive expertise in. In Graves’ disease, the immune system mistakenly targets the thyroid gland, leading to increased hormone production.

I’m a leader in the field of functional medicine, with a strong focus on thyroid health and autoimmunity. With years of experience and a passion for uncovering the root causes of health conditions, I’ve become a trusted source of knowledge and guidance.

More and more people are turning to functional medicine as an alternative approach to traditional healthcare, and I’m at the forefront of this movement. My webinar will provide valuable insights and practical strategies for those seeking natural, holistic approaches to address hyperthyroidism.

Now, here’s your chance to delve deeper into this subject. Join my FREE Webinar:

Platform: LIVE on Zoom or TikTok Live

![Image 8: 🗓️](https://s.w.org/images/core/emoji/17.0.2/svg/1f5d3.svg) Date: Wednesday, November 8th

![Image 9: 🕡](https://s.w.org/images/core/emoji/17.0.2/svg/1f561.svg) Time: 6:30pm MST | 8:30pm EST

### **This webinar is perfect for:**

*   Individuals suffering from hyperthyroidism
*   Those interested in functional medicine approaches
*   Anyone curious about the connection between autoimmunity and thyroid health

### **Expect to learn:**

*   Insights into the root causes of hyperthyroidism
*   Functional medicine strategies for healing
*   Practical tips and resources for managing your condition

Don’t miss this opportunity to empower yourself with knowledge and explore the potential of functional medicine in healing hyperthyroidism. Mark your calendar and register today!

Sign Me Up

[https://us02web.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_tJQUuyhWTuG14wx0g_zczg](https://us02web.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_tJQUuyhWTuG14wx0g_zczg)
